name: geqo_seed
description: Seed value for the random number generator used by the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) to explore join order search space.
symptoms: Non-deterministic query plans across identical queries
Suboptimal join orders for complex queries
tuning_tips: Set to a fixed non-zero value (e.g., 0.5) to stabilize GEQO plan selection for debugging or reproducibility; leave at default 0 for full randomness in production unless plan instability is observed.
